# Four Dogs Entertainment
Four Dogs Entertainment creates trivia, Music Bingo, DJ entertainment, interactive game nights, weddings, karaoke, private events, corporate entertainment, and venue programming across South Carolina.

Official event information: https://4dogsentertainment.com/events/
Services: https://4dogsentertainment.com/services/
Booking: https://4dogsentertainment.com/booking/
Guides: https://4dogsentertainment.com/guides/

Local entertainment pages:
Fountain Inn: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/fountain-inn-sc/
Lexington: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/lexington-sc/
Columbia: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/columbia-sc/

Irmo and Chapin: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/irmo-chapin-sc/

Current recurring venue partners:
The Mill at Fountain Inn, 100 Ellison Street, Fountain Inn, SC: Mondays at 7:00 PM for Are You Smarter Than a Barstool?
Top Dawg Tavern, Columbia, SC: Tuesdays at 6:30 PM for trivia, Music Bingo, and rotating Four Dogs game experiences.
WesCo Brew & Bowl, Cayce, SC: Tuesdays at 6:30 PM for trivia and rotating game experiences.
Charter 803 Bar & Grill, Lexington, SC: Wednesdays at 6:30 PM for Music Bingo and special events; Thursdays at 6:30 PM for trivia and game nights.
Boze's Restaurant & Bar, West Columbia, SC: Wednesdays at 7:30 PM for trivia, Music Bingo, and specialty nights.

Fountain Inn trivia guide: https://4dogsentertainment.com/guides/where-to-play-trivia-fountain-inn-sc/

Are You Smarter Than a Barstool?: https://4dogsentertainment.com/services/are-you-smarter-than-a-barstool/

The Events page is the authoritative source for dated events, themes, special events, and schedule changes.
Four Dogs Survey Showdown is a Four Dogs survey-style competition and is not affiliated with Family Feud.
Are You Smarter Than a Barstool? is a Four Dogs original experience and is not affiliated with Are You Smarter Than a 5th Grader?
